current_title: The channel-binding selector has no provenance: an omitted identity policy and an explicit uri_san are the same value, because the default is filled in the request types
evidence: Second review REFUTED the duplicate of 820a90603a6bfda1 (a positive-control with no rationale; the defect is still literally true): The cited later finding 820a90603a6bfda1 is status positive-control (defined in security-remediate/scripts/ledger.py:17 as 'an INFO finding confirming a good control is present') with refs {} — no rationale, so nothing adjudicated the provenance limb; the reconciler itself records the defect as 'still literally true'.
